description: You are a licensed structural engineer (PE) at Caldwell & Associates Structural Engineering. You performed a structural condition assessment of Riverside Office Complex at 1234 Commerce Drive and must now format your field notes (/home/ga/Documents/inspection_draft.docx) into a professional report ready for submission to the local building authority. The report must meet the following professional engineering standards: (1) Apply a multi-level numbered outline throughout the document: Level 1 section headings (Introduction, Scope of Assessment, Building Description, Structural Observations, Structural Calculations, Conclusions and Recommendations, Professional Engineer Certification) must use 'Heading 1' style and are numbered with the document's outline numbering; Level 2 subsection headings must use 'Heading 2' style; (2) The seven structural deficiency observations must each be formatted in a 3-column table (columns: 'Location', 'Deficiency Description', 'Recommended Action') with a bold header row and visible borders — each observation gets its own labeled table preceded by a bold observation label such as 'OBS-001 (Critical):', 'OBS-002 (Major):', etc.; (3) The Structural Calculations section contains three load calculations that must be reformatted as 4-column tables with columns 'Parameter', 'Value', 'Unit', 'Code Reference' — header row bold, all cell borders visible; (4) Apply LibreOffice's Caption style (using Insert > Caption with label 'Figure') to the five figure captions in the document, so they appear as 'Figure 1:', 'Figure 2:', etc. with the Caption paragraph style applied; (5) The Professional Engineer Certification section at the end must be formatted as a bordered single-cell table containing the full certification text including the PE license number (TX-78234) and the statement 'I hereby certify that this structural assessment was prepared by me or under my direct supervision'. Save the formatted report as /home/ga/Documents/inspection_report.docx.
